```{r}
  first_rating  = 1:8,   # Direct evidence: 0-8 blue marbles out of 8
```

```{r}
N <- 80 #number of faces

first_rating <- runif(N, 1, 8)
group_rating <- runif(N, 1, 8)
```


```{r}
# Core belief-update function implementing the Beta-Binomial integration model
betaBinomialModel <- function(alpha_prior = 0.5, beta_prior = 0.5,
                              first_rating, group_rating, max_rating, #changed it to one max rating and the name
                              w_direct = 1, w_social = 1) {
  
  alpha_post <- alpha_prior + w_direct * first_rating + w_social * group_rating
  beta_post  <- beta_prior  + w_direct * (max_rating - first_rating) +
    w_social * (max_rating - group_rating)
  
  expected_rate <- alpha_post / (alpha_post + beta_post)
  ci_lower      <- qbeta(0.025, alpha_post, beta_post)
  ci_upper      <- qbeta(0.975, alpha_post, beta_post)
  
  list(
    alpha_post    = alpha_post,
    beta_post     = beta_post,
    expected_rate = expected_rate,
    ci_lower      = ci_lower,
    ci_upper      = ci_upper
  )
}

```

```{r}
# Function to generate decisions from a simulated agent
generate_agent_decisions <- function(weight_direct, weight_social,
                                     evidence_df, n_samples = 80) {
  evidence_df |>
    slice(rep(seq_len(n()), each = n_samples)) |>
    group_by(first_rating, group_rating, max_rating) |>
    mutate(sample_id = seq_len(n())) |>
    ungroup() |>
    pmap_dfr(function(first_rating, group_rating, max_rating, sample_id) {
      result <- betaBinomialModel(
        0.5, 0.5, first_rating, group_rating, max_rating,
        w_direct = weight_direct, w_social = weight_social
      )
      # Probability matching: sample θ from Beta, then sample second_rating from Bernoulli(θ)
      alpha_p <- result$alpha_post
      beta_p  <- result$beta_post
      p       <- rbeta(1, alpha_p, beta_p)
      tibble(
        sample_id     = sample_id,
        first_rating  = first_rating,
        group_rating  = group_rating,
        max_rating    = max_rating,
        expected_rate = result$expected_rate,
        second_rating       = rbinom(1, 7, p)+1
      )
    })
}
```

```{r}
prepare_stan_data <- function(df) {
  list(
    N             = nrow(df),
    second_rating = df$second_rating,
    first_rating  = df$first_rating,
    max_rating    = df$max_rating,
    group_rating  = df$group_rating
  )
}

```

## Simple Bayes Agent (SBA)
```{r}
SimpleAgent_stan <- "
// Simple Bayesian Agent (SBA).
// No free parameters — evidence is counted at face value.
// Jeffreys prior pseudo-counts: alpha0 = beta0 = 0.5.
data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=8> first_rating;
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=8> group_rating;
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=8> second_rating; // changing choice to second rating
}

transformed data {
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=7> first_rating_transformed;
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=7> group_rating_transformed;
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=7> second_rating_transformed;
  
  for (n in 1:N) {
    first_rating_transformed[n]  = first_rating[n]  - 1;
    group_rating_transformed[n]  = group_rating[n]  - 1;
    second_rating_transformed[n] = second_rating[n] - 1;
  }
}

model {
  // Vectorized likelihood with fixed weights = 1
  vector[N] alpha_post = 0.5 + to_vector(first_rating_transformed) + to_vector(group_rating_transformed);
  vector[N] beta_post  = 0.5 + (7 - to_vector(first_rating_transformed))
                             + (7 - to_vector(group_rating_transformed));
                             
  target += beta_binomial_lpmf(second_rating_transformed | 7, alpha_post, beta_post); 
  // 7 choices plus 1 puts us on the scale from 1 to 8
}

generated quantities {
  vector[N] log_lik;
  array[N] int posterior_pred;

  for (i in 1:N) {
    real alpha_post = 0.5 + first_rating_transformed[i] + group_rating_transformed[i];
    real beta_post  = 0.5 + (7 - first_rating_transformed[i]) + (7 - group_rating_transformed[i]);

    log_lik[i]        = beta_binomial_lpmf(second_rating_transformed[i] | 7, alpha_post, beta_post);
    posterior_pred[i] = beta_binomial_rng(7, alpha_post, beta_post);
  }
}
"

write_stan_file(SimpleAgent_stan,
                dir      = "stan/",
                basename = "ch9_simple_agent.stan")
```


## Weighted Bayes Agent (WBA)
```{r}
WeightedAgent_stan <- "
// Weighted Bayesian Agent (raw parameterisation).
// w_d, w_s > 0: independent weights on direct and social evidence.
// Jeffreys prior pseudo-counts (0.5) consistent with SBA.

data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=8> first_rating;
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=8> group_rating;
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=8> second_rating;
}

transformed data {
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=7> first_rating_transformed;
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=7> group_rating_transformed;
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=7> second_rating_transformed;
  
  for (n in 1:N) {
    first_rating_transformed[n]  = first_rating[n]  - 1;
    group_rating_transformed[n]  = group_rating[n]  - 1;
    second_rating_transformed[n] = second_rating[n] - 1;
  }
}

parameters {
  real<lower=0, upper=1> rho;  // ratio of weights
  real<lower=0> kappa;  // sum of weights
}

transformed parameters {
  real<lower=0> weight_direct = rho * kappa;  // the weight for own observation is rho times kappa
  real<lower=0> weight_social = (1.0 - rho) * kappa;  // the weight for group observations is 1 minus rho times kappa 
}

model {
  // weakly centered prior for rho
  target += beta_lpdf(rho |  2,2); 
  
  //lognormal prior for kappa, concetration aroun .5 to 5
  target += lognormal_lpdf(kappa | log(2), 0.5); 
  
  // Vectorized likelihood
  vector[N] alpha_post = 0.5 + weight_direct * to_vector(first_rating_transformed)
                             + weight_social * to_vector(group_rating_transformed);
  vector[N] beta_post  = 0.5 + weight_direct * (7 - to_vector(first_rating_transformed))
                             + weight_social * (7 - to_vector(group_rating_transformed));
                             
  target += beta_binomial_lpmf(second_rating_transformed | 7, alpha_post, beta_post);
}

generated quantities {
  vector[N] log_lik;
  array[N] int prior_pred;
  array[N] int posterior_pred;
  real lprior;
  //accumulator for joint prior log density required by priorsense
  lprior = beta_lpdf(rho | 2,2) + lognormal_lpdf(kappa | log(2),0.5);
  
  //prior samples for predictive checks
  real rho_prior = beta_rng(2,2);
  real kappa_prior = lognormal_rng(log(2),0.5);
  real wd_prior = rho_prior * kappa_prior;
  real ws_prior = (1-rho_prior) * kappa_prior;
  
  
  for (i in 1:N) {
  // posterior prediction
    real alpha_post = 0.5 + weight_direct * first_rating_transformed[i] + weight_social * group_rating_transformed[i];
    real beta_post  = 0.5 + weight_direct * (7 - first_rating_transformed[i]) 
                         + weight_social * (7 - group_rating_transformed[i]);

    log_lik[i]        = beta_binomial_lpmf(second_rating_transformed[i] | 7, alpha_post, beta_post);
    posterior_pred[i] = beta_binomial_rng(7, alpha_post, beta_post) + 1;
    
  //prior predictions using sampled prior weights
    real ap = 0.5 + wd_prior * first_rating_transformed[i] + ws_prior * group_rating_transformed[i];
    real bp = 0.5 + wd_prior * (7 - first_rating_transformed[i]) + ws_prior * (7 - group_rating_transformed[i]);
    prior_pred[i] = beta_binomial_rng(7, ap, bp) + 1;
  }
}
"

write_stan_file(WeightedAgent_stan,
                dir      = "stan/",
                basename = "ch9_weighted_agent.stan")
```

```{r}
# Check diagnostics
check_diagnostics <- function(fit, label) {
  diag_smry <- fit$diagnostic_summary()
  min_ebfmi <- min(diag_smry$ebfmi)
  
  smry <- fit$summary() |> filter(!is.na(rhat))
  n_fail <- smry |> filter(rhat > 1.01 | ess_bulk < 400 | ess_tail < 400) |> nrow()
  
  cat(sprintf("%-25s | Divs: %3d | Min E-BFMI: %.2f | Failures: %d\n", 
              label, sum(diag_smry$num_divergent), min_ebfmi, n_fail))
}
```

```{r}
## prior/posterior predictive checks
# Generalized Extraction Function for Posteriors
extract_predictive_data <- function(fit, stan_data, scenario_name, target_var = "posterior_pred") {
  obs_df <- tibble(
    obs_id = seq_len(stan_data$N),
    first_rating  = stan_data$first_rating,
    group_rating  = stan_data$group_rating,
    second_rating = stan_data$second_rating
  )

  pred_samples <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit$draws(target_var)) |>
    dplyr::select(-.chain, -.iteration) |> 
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::starts_with(target_var), 
      names_to = "obs_id", 
      values_to = "pred"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(obs_id = readr::parse_number(obs_id))

  obs_summary <- obs_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    dplyr::summarise(p_obs = mean(second_rating), .groups = "drop")

  pred_summary <- pred_samples |>
    dplyr::left_join(obs_df, by = "obs_id") |>
    dplyr::group_by(.draw, first_rating, group_rating) |>
    dplyr::summarise(p_draw = mean(pred), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      p_pred = median(p_draw),
      lower  = quantile(p_draw, 0.025),
      upper  = quantile(p_draw, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(obs_summary, by = c("first_rating", "group_rating")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
            social_evidence = factor(
        group_rating, levels = 1:8,
        labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8")
      ),
      Scenario = scenario_name
    )
  
  return(pred_summary)
}
```




```{r}
# Standardized Plotting Function
plot_predictive_check <- function(plot_data, title, subtitle) {
  
  semantic_colors <- c("1"  = "#d73027", "3"  = "#fdae61",
                       "5" = "#abd9e9", "7" = "#4575b4",
                       "2"  = "#d73027", "4"  = "#fdae61",
                       "6" = "#abd9e9", "8" = "#4575b4")
  
  ggplot(plot_data, 
         aes(x = first_rating, colour = social_evidence, fill = social_evidence)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower+1, ymax = upper+1),
                   position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), 
                   alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = p_pred+1), 
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), 
              linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = p_obs), 
               shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.8, size = 2,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    facet_wrap(~ Scenario) +
    scale_color_manual(values = semantic_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = semantic_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:8) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1,8)) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x        = "First rating",
      y        = "Second rating",
      colour   = "Social evidence", 
      fill     = "Social evidence"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
}
```

```{r}
# Custom R function to generate Prior predictions for the raw model
generate_wba_raw_prior <- function(stan_data, scenario_name, n_draws = 4000) {
  
  obs_df <- tibble(
    obs_id = seq_len(stan_data$N),
    first_rating  = stan_data$first_rating,
    group_rating  = stan_data$group_rating,
    second_rating = stan_data$second_rating
  )

  # 1. Draw parameters from the priors defined in the raw Stan model
  wd_prior <- rlnorm(n_draws, 0, 0.5)
  ws_prior <- rlnorm(n_draws, 0, 0.5)

  # 2. Simulate second_ratings across all draws and observations
  pred_samples <- expand_grid(.draw = 1:n_draws, obs_id = obs_df$obs_id) |>
    left_join(obs_df, by = "obs_id") |>
    mutate(
      wd = wd_prior[.draw],
      ws = ws_prior[.draw],
      alpha_post = 0.5 + wd * first_rating + ws * group_rating,
      beta_post  = 0.5 + wd * (8 - first_rating) + ws * (8 - group_rating),
      
      # Probability matching: sample belief, then sample second_rating
      theta = rbeta(n(), alpha_post, beta_post),
      pred  = rbinom(n(), 7, theta)
    )

  # 3. Summarize in the exact same format as the posterior function
  obs_summary <- obs_df |>
    group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    summarise(p_obs = mean(second_rating), .groups = "drop")

  pred_summary <- pred_samples |>
    group_by(.draw, first_rating, group_rating) |>
    summarise(p_draw = mean(pred), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(first_rating, group_rating) |>
    summarise(
      p_pred = median(p_draw),
      lower  = quantile(p_draw, 0.025),
      upper  = quantile(p_draw, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(obs_summary, by = c("first_rating", "group_rating")) |>
    mutate(
        social_evidence = factor(
        group_rating, levels = 1:8,
        labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8")
      ),
      Scenario = scenario_name
    )

  return(pred_summary)
}

# Extract PRIOR predictive checks by simulating in R
wba_prior_ppc <- imap_dfr(stan_data_wba, ~ generate_wba_raw_prior(.x, .y))

# Plot PRIOR
plot_predictive_check(
  wba_prior_ppc,
  title = "Prior Predictive Checks: WBA",
  subtitle = "Lines/Bars = Predicted second rating from Prior alone ± 95% CI | Circles = Observed"
)
```

```{r}
  wba_post_ppc,
  title = "Posterior Predictive Checks: WBA",
  subtitle = "Lines/Bars = Predicted second rating after fitting ± 95% CI | Circles = Observed"
)
```

#### FIT THE REAL DATA

```{r}
df_renamed <- df %>% 
  rename(first_rating = FirstRating, 
         group_rating = GroupRating,
         second_rating = SecondRating
         )

df_renamed <- df_renamed %>% 
  mutate(max_rating = 8
         )

df_cleaned <- df_renamed %>% 
  filter(group_rating != 0)

```


```{r}
df_stan <- prepare_stan_data(df_cleaned)
df_stan
```

```{r}
#removed PBA - pssibly replace PBA part with SBA from above at some point
if (regenerate_simulations || !all(file.exists(sprintf("simmodels/ch10_fit_wba_%s.rds", names(stan_data_wba))))) {
  # --- Fit WBA reparameterised ---
  fit_wba <- map2(stan_data_wba_reparam, 204:206, function(data, seed) {
    do.call(mod_weighted$sample,
            c(list(data = data, seed = seed), sampler_args))
  })
  names(fit_wba) <- names(stan_data_wba_reparam)
  iwalk(fit_wba, ~ .x$save_object(
    sprintf("simmodels/ch10_fit_wba_%s.rds", .y)
  ))
} else {
  fit_wba <- map(
    names(stan_data_wba_reparam),
    ~ readRDS(sprintf("simmodels/ch10_fit_wba_%s.rds", .x))
  ) |> set_names(names(stan_data_wba_reparam))
}
```


```{r}
fit <- mod_simple$sample(
      data          = df_stan,
      chains        = 4,
      iter_warmup   = 1000,
      iter_sampling = 1000,
      fixed_param   = TRUE,
      refresh       = 0
    )
```

```{r}
purrr::iwalk(fit, ~ check_diagnostics(.x, paste("WBA", .y)))
```
